data.name: Khileshwar
data.gender_notes: Khileshwar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Khileshwar is derived from two Sanskrit words 'Khila' which means 'battlefield' and 'Ishwar' which means 'Lord'. The name signifies a powerful warrior who is the Lord of the battlefield. This name is given to a boy who is believed to be brave, courageous and strong. The name Khileshwar carries the meaning “Lord of the battlefield” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Khileshwar usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the battlefield and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Khileshwar has deep cultural significance in the Hindu tradition where the warrior spirit is highly revered. The name symbolizes courage, bravery, and strength, qualities that are admired and respected in Hindu society. Legend has it that Lord Shiva himself appeared in the form of Khileshwar to aid the gods in their battles against the demonic forces. This name is also given to young boys during the Karva Chauth festival, a day when Hindu women pray for the longevity and strength of their husbands.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Khileshwar signifies the inner warrior that exists within each one of us. It is a reminder of the courage and strength that we possess to overcome the challenges and obstacles in our lives. The name also signifies the presence of God as our protector and guide, especially during times of battle or struggle. It serves as a constant reminder that we are never alone and that we have the divine support and blessings to help us through difficult times.
